items.prompt: Photorealistic luxury watch photograph shot on a real camera with a macro lens, vertical frame. The watch is EXACTLY the one in the reference photo (same steel case, plain black dial with three silver sub-dials and their numbers, numbered bezel, luminous hands and indices, crown and pushers, brown leather strap with dark stitching), seen from the SAME three-quarter angle, close-up on the dial and bezel. Resting on a dark brown leather surface. Warm amber key light from the side, natural soft falloff into a dark warm background, real reflections on the sapphire crystal and polished steel, shallow depth of field. Understated, natural, like a real high-end watch catalogue. No effects, no particles, no glow, no water, no text, no logo on the dial, no people, no hands.
